headline: Far fewer United flights are in the air than usual right now.

items.text: 174 United flights are in the air right now, 73% fewer than usual for this time of day; the median at this hour over the past 7 days was 651.

The FAA has a ground delay program for flights into San Francisco until 11:59 PM PT because of wind, with delays averaging 138 minutes and up to 690 minutes. San Francisco also has 3 confirmed cancellations among its 323 departures today.

Los Angeles is the lowest of the seven United hubs reporting, with 73% of departures so far today leaving within 30 minutes of schedule (52 departed). Newark has rain and somewhat low clouds or visibility, which can cause minor delays.

A ground stop holds flights into Toronto until 6:15 PM ET, and the FAA rates the chance of an extension as high. Ground delay programs also hold flights into Boston until 9:59 PM ET and into New York LaGuardia until 10:59 PM ET.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to San Francisco, check your flight status before leaving for the airport, and do the same if you are flying to Toronto, Boston or LaGuardia.
